# Naviamp vX.Y.Z

One or two sentences explaining the release's purpose and most important user-visible outcome.

Highlights:

- No more than three concise, product-significant highlights.

## Features

- Describe the capability and why it is useful. Link its GitHub issue and pull request.

## Improvements

- Describe a meaningful improvement to previously released behavior.

## Bug fixes

- State what was broken in the previous public release and what is now restored.

## Upgrade notes

No special upgrade steps, or explain the required action.

## Known issues

No new known issues, or describe each relevant limitation.

## Links

- Download: `https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/releases/tag/vX.Y.Z`
- Compare: `https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/compare/vX.Y.W...vX.Y.Z`
- Milestone: `https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/milestone/NUMBER?closed=1`

Use the previous public release as the baseline. Do not list prerelease implementation history as
public fixes. Rank changes by product significance, use absolute GitHub links, and do not use emoji.
